concept: Single near-black still, continuous noise bed, 8h
audience: Adults 25-55 who sleep with sound masking; light-sensitive sleepers; shift workers
hypothesis: Watch-time-driven ad impressions on very long sessions; audience returns nightly. UNVERIFIED.
visual_style: Deep blue-black radial wash, held static. Deliberately minimal.
title_candidates: Brown Noise for Deep Sleep | 30 Minutes | Dark Screen
Brown Noise for Sleep and Sound Masking | 30 Minutes
Dark Screen Brown Noise | 30 Minutes | No Music
selected_title: Brown Noise for Deep Sleep | 30 Minutes | Dark Screen
description: 30 minutes of continuous brown noise on a dark screen, for sleep and sound masking. The audio is synthesised locally and loops without a seam. No music and no field recordings are used.
thumbnail_concept: Very dark frame at or above ~#1a1a2e (perceived luma >=26) with a barely visible gradient. MEASURED: darker than this trips QC blackdetect. No motion.

audio_plan.capability: AVAILABLE - noise/tone/rain providers synthesise this today
audio_plan.concept: Generated brown/pink noise. Fully synthesisable with FFmpeg's anoisesrc today - zero external dependency.

images.notes: A dark static plate is the intended deliverable for this format, not a stand-in for photography. Luma verified above the QC black floor.

kill_evidence: Median view duration < 5 min across 3 uploads
open_questions: Current YouTube inauthentic-content policy text and how it treats static-image noise uploads
Whether extreme-length uploads are favoured or suppressed by recommendation

review_checklist: Confirm the dark plate renders acceptably on OLED and on phone screens.
